text:
Evelyn: Quick alert — Silverpine's onboarding exports produce intermittent tail latency on long chain-of-thought prompts during nightly runs. p95 rose from ~2.3s to ~7.6s on ~14k-token pipelines. Renewal sync in 6 days, they'd like a low-risk fix we can ship today.
Noah: Any details on model, route, quant? logs?
Evelyn: They're on hosted gptx-3-8b, default routing, no quant. Logs show bursts between 01:30-02:30 UTC; many requests tagged 'export' with repeated headers.
Tarek: Suggest layered approach: (A) micro-batching + prefix cache on client for exports; (B) canary a soft-int8 variant on dedicated pool for export-tagged long requests; (C) run a shadow-quality pass on 100 synthetic prompts to detect regressions before promoting.
Noah: Shadow quality pass sounds good. Will run a synthetic suite that includes chain-of-thought examples and code-like prompts to catch punctuation drift.
Evelyn: Proposed steps:
1) Noah builds synthetic prompt set (50 chain-of-thought + 50 edge cases) — 1.5h.
2) Tarek provisions 2-GPU dedicated pool in us-west and deploys route rule: if request.headers['X-Job']=='export' && prompt_tokens >= 8192 -> dedicated-softint8-usw.
3) Run shadow-mode: duplicate but do not route traffic; compare outputs baseline vs soft-int8 using automated token-delta + hallucination checks.
4) If shadow pass within thresholds, canary 5% export traffic for 3h with immediate fallback on 5xx or p95 > 10s.
5) Collect CS feedback and include artifacts in renewal deck.
Tarek: I can provision pool and add fallback: if error_rate > 0.5% OR p95 > 9s -> automatic fallback to hosted-default and auto-alert channel. Will add SLA tag guard so only Silverpine traffic enters path.
Noah: Running shadow eval now. Command:
```
./shadow_eval.sh --base=gptx-3-8b --alt=gptx-3-8b-softint8 --prompts=silverpine_synthetic.json --metrics=token_delta,perplexity,hallucination
```
I'll post artifacts in cs/artifacts/silverpine/.
monitor-bot: Provisioning request accepted (job: prov-3501). ETA pool ready ~7m. Shadow job queued.
Evelyn: Owners: Noah (synthetic eval + quality signoff), Tarek (provision + routing + fallback), Evelyn (CS comms + renewal notes). We'll schedule a short customer note after the 3h canary. Any objections?
Noah: Shadow eval results: token-delta within thresholds; perplexity +0.8%; 0/100 hallucination flags. Good to canary.
Tarek: Pool provisioned and route rule deployed. Canary live at 02:12 UTC. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/obs/silverpine/3501239999
monitor-bot: Canary started. 5% export-tagged traffic -> dedicated-softint8-usw. Health checks every 5m.
Evelyn: Early telemetry: canary cohort p95 down to ~2.0s vs baseline 7.6s. No quality alerts. I'll draft renewal note to highlight the improvement and next steps (micro-batching + staged rollout).
Noah: I'll upload eval artifacts and the synthetic suite to the CS folder for audit.
Tarek: I'll keep fallback active and schedule escalation 5% -> 30% after 6h if stable.
Evelyn: Closing loop: will update after 24h. Thanks team :raised_hands:
